model_family: SVM (RBF kernel) on pooled MFCC/spectral statistics
limitations: Trained only on acted speech (Emo-DB: 10 German actors; SAVEE: 4 male English actors). Natural, everyday speech is usually much less exaggerated.
Only 14 speakers in total, so results vary a lot from one speaker to another.
Recording conditions (studio microphones) differ from phones and laptops; background noise lowers accuracy.
It estimates the emotion expressed in the voice in one clip. It does not measure how a person feels overall, their mood over time, or their mental health.
Only six emotion categories are recognised; everything else is forced into one of them.
Evaluation scores come from held-out actors in the same two corpora, not from real-world use.
prediction: vocal emotion expressed in one audio clip
preprocessing: 16 kHz mono; trim silence (top_db=30.0); peak-normalise; ml/src/features.py
